notes.title: Ipseity Arena Playtest Patch 0.37
notes.content:
[h1]The Final Playtest patch is finally out for everyone to play! [/h1]

PATCH NOTES:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which the Walljumper Ipseity was able to infinitely jump, now there's a max jump amount of 3.
[*] Added damageable lava for maps with lava such as Amphi and Light Divinity, standing for too long on the lava will damage you overtime.
[*] Added dedicated audio settings to the game
[*] Added In-game settings, change your audio, sensitivity, crosshair, and other miscellaneous settings 
[*] Want to play against other players? A pickup bot has been introduced into the game's official server, go to the ipseity pickups channel and search for people!
[/list]

This is it for the Playtests in terms of non bug fix updates, if there's any patches needed, feel free to post in the discord down below for bugs that need to be fixed.

https://discord.gg/we42YrTKe6

notes.title: 0.31 RELEASE!
notes.content:
[h1]After years of work, I am proud to announce that Ipseity: Arena Playtest is out for everyone![/h1]

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Reworked Hitscan Registration In order to feel more client-side
[*] New Menu UI
[*] New Server Browser Support, shows which matches are going on with how many people are in the server, and what game mode!
[*] New Steam Lobby Support for 2v2 Game modes
[*] 2 New Maps, Light Divinity for Duels and The Vow for 2v2's!
[*] New Scoreboard UI for Duels and 2v2, shows how many kills, Ipseity: Type, and weapon accuracy for the holy Trinity!
[*] New Simple Item positions for Armors on each map, for players to get used to item positions
[*] New Social Game mode, 1v1 Vamp LG for Thunderstruck, improve your LG aim!
[/list]

I appreciate your support, and happy fragging!

notes.title: IPSEITY ARENA UPDATE 0.23:
notes.content:
[h1]I sadly did not make this update patch note while eating a bagel, but instead eating a taco :D[/h1]

[h2]0.23 PATCH NOTES: (TIME FOR WEAPON CHANGES, HITSOUNDS AND SOME OTHER STUFF I GUESS?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased Set damage for Rocket Launcher to 100 from 90, and increased knockback by 30%, now you should see quake 1 level rocket knockback!
[*] Increased Weapon Damage for the Lightning Cannon from 10 damage -> 15 Damage, this will be temporary for this patch.
[*] Increased Rail damage from 70 to 80 Damage also temporary but should allow combos to deal more DPM
[*] Added Hitsounds when hitting people! Next major update will allow customizable hitsounds
[*] Fixed death sound to play both client and server side, now kills will play the death sound (hopefully!)
[*] Updated Monsoon's name to "Monlate" to fit with the name of Aerostroll
[*] (Hopefully) fixed a situation where the player's z rotation of the weapon model still flipped over, if this still happens send me a message on discord, i swear it shouldn't be doing this lol, and with the new camera system in the next major update for spectator cameras, it should be gone.
[/list]

That is it for Version 0.2 so far, the game will be reworked for the next month to be on rollback netcode as well as using a lobby system for servers for team based game mode support!

If you want a key to play, go through the discord and go into #ipseity-waiting-line to get access!

Happy Fragging!

notes.title: IPSEITY: ARENA PLAYTEST IS FINALLY AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[h1]WELCOME TO ONE OF THE MOST EXPRESSIVE FPS GAMES OF ALL TIME....[/h1]

Ipseity: Arena has finally launched it's first playtest!
This playtest is meant to showcase basic mechanics of the game and it's first two game-modes, Duel on Aerostroll, Monsoon, as well as Aim Duel on Thunder Struck and Amphi.

To watch the trailer for the game to get a view of what is possible within the game, here it is below :)

[previewyoutube=9oSgk9kC3-k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

If you want to ensure playtest access, it will be per each update, and to be notified and get access, join the discord down below and let yourself be known, as other playtesters may request more people to playtest with!

https://discord.gg/we42YrTKe6

Happy fragging!
